title: hieracium rohacsense subsp. subsenile
intro: Hieracium rohacsense subsp. subsenile, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including inflammation and infections, due to its reported health benefits of boosting the immune system and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium rohacsense subsp. subsenile are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from external pathogens. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
